<title level="1" right="Rules">[Observed](/Rules.aspx?ID=2415)</title>

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 434

<row gap="medium">
<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">
In most circumstances, you can sense creatures without difficulty and target them normally. Creatures in this state are observed. Observing requires a precise sense, which for most creatures means sight. If you can’t observe the creature, it’s either hidden, undetected, or unnoticed, and you’ll need to factor in the targeting restrictions. Even if a creature is observed, it might still be concealed.
</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>
